positions.as_written: Expect inconsistent demonstration on magnetic resonance imaging.
Treat this ligament as the component whose reconstruction distinguishes an anatomic corner procedure from a tenodesis, and treat the fibular head as the crowded and fragile part of the operation.
Plan fibular fixation around the crowding and the bone quality.
